steps.title: Validate the classroom experiment
steps.explanation: Only a fixed mode is accepted. Browser requests cannot inject arbitrary prompts, executable paths or tool definitions.

steps.title: Prepare separate attempt state
steps.explanation: Each attempt gets its own SDK home, config and debug file beneath a unique temporary workspace. A fictional note is the only permitted file.
steps.narration: Step 2. Each attempt gets its own SDK home, config and debug file beneath a unique temporary workspace. A fictional note is the only permitted file. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Select the model and limits
steps.code:
model:
          fault && c.mode === "invalidmodel"
            ? "classroom-model-does-not-exist-50"
            : MODEL,
        tools: ["Read"],
        allowedTools:
          wantsJson && !(fault && c.mode === "missing")
            ? ["Read", "StructuredOutput"]
            : ["Read"],
        permissionMode: "dontAsk",
        settingSources: [],
        plugins: [],
steps.explanation: Start from a known-good model and Read-only task. Fault modes deliberately change the model or turn allowance. JSON runs allow sufficient turns for Read and StructuredOutput.
steps.narration: Step 3. Start from a known-good model and Read-only task. Fault modes deliberately change the model or turn allowance. JSON runs allow sufficient turns for Read and StructuredOutput. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Capture actual stderr
steps.explanation: The SDK stderr callback stores a bounded redacted tail and emits separate observations. Stderr is not an assistant answer and must not overwrite native messages.

steps.title: Start one real query per attempt
steps.explanation: query starts the real SDK with the selected options. Consume the async stream and retain every observed type and subtype rather than guessing from visible text.

steps.title: Inspect initialization metadata
steps.explanation: Read initialization model, tools, MCP servers, skills and plugin errors. An init message confirms startup, not successful task completion.

steps.title: Preserve native result fields
steps.code:
record.result = {
              attempt: index,
              sessionId: message.session_id,
              status: message.subtype,
              costUsd: message.total_cost_usd,
              stopReason: message.stop_reason,
              permissionDenials: message.permission_denials,
              structuredOutputPresent:
                message.subtype === "success" &&
                message.structured_output !== undefined,
steps.explanation: Keep the native subtype, session, stop reason, denials, estimate and structured-output presence. A raw success result can still be followed by an SDK error exception.
steps.narration: Step 9. Keep the native subtype, session, stop reason, denials, estimate and structured-output presence. A raw success result can still be followed by an SDK error exception. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Retain SDK exceptions separately
steps.explanation: TypeScript may throw an ordinary Error. Preserve its name and full redacted report separately from the raw result; the diagnostic classifier reads both.
steps.narration: Step 10. TypeScript may throw an ordinary Error. Preserve its name and full redacted report separately from the raw result; the diagnostic classifier reads both. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Require structured field presence
steps.explanation: A successful result without the requested field fails application validation. Presence is checked against undefined so valid false or zero values are not mistaken for absence.
steps.narration: Step 11. A successful result without the requested field fails application validation. Presence is checked against undefined so valid false or zero values are not mistaken for absence. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Read the native error report first
steps.explanation: The exception report after the colon takes priority even if a raw result says success. Keep process exit, startup and native error reports distinct; do not rewrite provider fields.
anchors: if (/Claude Code returned an error result:/i.test(message))

steps.title: Rerun the corrected configuration
steps.explanation: After a reproduced fault, make a fresh corrected attempt, verify the note is unchanged and publish independent recovery evidence. Finally remove only the unique temporary workspace.
